text: Saint John Henry Newman. October 9 is his optional memorial. Most people know he left the Church of England, but in 1833 he fell ill in Sicily and almost died. He said to his servant, I shall not die. I have a work to do in England. He recovered and, with friends, began the Oxford Movement. In 1845 he asked a poor Italian missionary to hear his confession and entered the Catholic Church. In 1879 Pope Leo XIII named him a cardinal and granted his plea not to be consecrated a bishop. His motto was Heart speaks to heart. If the work is not finished, do not call the life over. Search Saint Match on the App Store. Feel it. Match a saint who lived it.
